assessmentBasis.comparisonObservation: UI/UX Pro Max raw recommendation was materially identical to girasol despite different concept/query.

candidates.recommendation: Hero + Testimonials + CTA; Hero > Problem statement > Solution overview > Testimonials carousel > CTA
reasons: Social proof can support conversion, but Lumi's concept needs comparison/choice-support presentation rather than a generic problem-solution funnel.
The identical recommendation for girasol shows insufficient store specificity.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Do not adopt the section formula unchanged. Rebuild around ambiguity-to-choice support, style comparison, evidence, and decision support.

candidates.recommendation: Soft UI Evolution with subtle depth, improved shadows, hybrid modern aesthetics
reasons: The style is a generic UI preset and does not express Lumi's refined proposal/choice-support concept.
The same style was returned for girasol.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Retain only restrained depth/clarity principles if useful; derive the visual language from Lumi's refined comparison and choice-support concept.

candidates.revisionInstruction: Reject palette. Retain Lumi's neutral charcoal / taupe / off-white direction unless newer evidence justifies revision.

reasons: Editorial refinement may be compatible with Lumi, but the exact pair is not store-derived and was also returned for girasol.
candidates.revisionInstruction: Treat as one candidate. Compare against a cleaner contemporary serif/sans or all-sans hierarchy that better supports structured comparison.

candidates.recommendation: Text contrast 4.5:1 minimum, visible keyboard focus, keyboard-accessible controls, prefers-reduced-motion support
reasons: These are cross-store UX/accessibility guardrails and are expected to remain consistent.

candidates.recommendation: Validate responsive behavior at 375px, 768px, 1024px, and 1440px; clickable elements need clear pointer/interaction states
reasons: Responsive and interaction QA are production-wide fixed requirements rather than store creative decisions.
